description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the Location model within the Opencart admin localisation namespace. It provides methods for CRUD operations related to 'location' entities within the database, such as addLocation, editLocation, deleteLocation, getLocation, getLocations, and getTotalLocations.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Model class managing CRUD operations for location entities in the database within the Opencart admin localisation namespace.

methods.name: addLocation
methods.description: Inserts a new location record into the database with data provided in an associative array, and returns the inserted record's ID.

methods.name: editLocation
methods.description: Updates an existing location record identified by location_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteLocation
methods.description: Deletes a location record from the database based on the provided location_id.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a single location record from the database based on location_id.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Fetches a list of location records from the database with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLocations
methods.description: Returns the total count of location records in the database.
